additionalComponents.text: Secular intervention supplies a rival mechanism of moral correction and questions whether internal evolution is sufficient.

response.rationale: The response directly contacts moral authority and correction by showing secular institutions restraining failures that religious institutions concealed or defended.

responsivenessWithinClass.rationale: This strong full answer targets the institutional-authority inference with concrete counterexamples, while not refuting every personal or doctrinal moral good.

charityAssessment.alternative: Religious traditions may contain moral resources and self-correction even when particular institutions conceal abuse.
